message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake:

| Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9‑inch round cake) |
|------------|------------------------------------------|
| All‑purpose flour | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) |
| Granulated sugar | 2 cups (400 g) |
| Unsweetened cocoa powder | ¾ cup (75 g) |
| Baking soda | 1 ½ teaspoons |
| Baking powder | 1 ½ teaspoons |
| Salt | 1 teaspoon |
| Buttermilk (or whole milk + 1 Tbsp vinegar/lemon juice) | 1 cup (240 ml) |
| Vegetable oil (or melted butter) | ⅔ cup (150 ml) |
| Eggs | 2 large |
| Vanilla extract | 2 Tbsp |
| Boiling water (or hot coffee for richer flavor) | 1 cup (240 ml) |

**Optional extras**  
- **Chocolate chips or chunks** – ½ cup (optional, for extra texture)  
- **Coffee** – 1–2 Tbsp brewed strong (enhances chocolate flavor)  

These amounts will give you a moist, fluffy chocolate cake with a rich chocolate flavor. Adjust the quantities if you’re making a different size or using a different pan shape. Happy baking!
